title: Data of an rf event (Companion)
description: A managed device's reply to this Companion's rf.request (from, xid, message), or a compact report it sent (from, report: the signed bytes, base64; TELEMETRY.md); or, when a reply arrived whole but would not fit an event once escaped, {from, xid, error: too-large or queue-full, size}. Or a block answer of a LoRa update transfer (LORA_UPDATES.md section 6), as it came from the node bulk frames were sent to: {from, answer}, the 22 bytes in base64, never decoded or changed by the gateway.

from.description: The sender's node key, or its 8-byte prefix for a reply on the management channel.
The sender's node key, or its 8-byte prefix for a reply on the management channel.
The node key bulk frames were sent to.

answer.description: The block answer, 22 bytes, base64 (32 characters with its padding).

from.description: The sender's node key, or its 8-byte prefix for a reply on the management channel.

size.description: The reply's length in bytes. too-large: it arrived whole but would not fit an event once escaped. queue-full: its event waited 10 s for room on a subscribed link's queue and was dropped.
